title: General-education nationwide strike call, not observed in schools
reason: The contemporary local report states the strike announced for 21 February was not observed on the ground because classes were held. The article describes a union session/declaration, not a public mass gathering; no participant count or public assembly is reported.
notes: Demands concerned salary arrears, teacher regulations and employment decisions directed at the Congolese government. No public meeting is inferred from the 12 signatories to the declaration.

title: Université Marien Ngouabi indefinite strike, 18–20 February
reason: Reports establish an actual work stoppage/strike and its lifting, but the sources do not establish an actual public gathering or simultaneous attendance. Announcements and work stoppages alone do not satisfy the public-assembly event rule.
notes: S007 says the strike was declared effective 18 February and lifted on 20 February after talks with government; S008 is search-only contemporaneous excerpt about the strike notice and is not independent attendance evidence. No assembly is inferred from the union’s membership or the extent of the university workforce.
